title: Customer Control Mapping & Prioritized Remediation Pipeline for Enterprise Questionnaires
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submit vendor questionnaires and bespoke contractual asks that require manual review from Security, Legal, and Product. That manual triage is slow, inconsistent, and blocks sales and onboarding. Goal: Build an automated control-ask extraction and mapping pipeline that produces a normalized control matrix, computes a priority/risk score per ask, and surfaces a prioritized remediation roadmap to Sales/CS/Engineering and Security. This ticket defines the product flow, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan for the minimum viable pipeline.
background: We currently receive ~30 complex questionnaires/month for enterprise trials. Turnaround for answers is 3-6 weeks on average. Sales has escalated for two logo accounts where questionnaire delay threatened deals. Existing playbooks are ad hoc (see PM-23456). This initiative targets a cross-functional solution to accelerate and standardize response while preserving legal and security oversight.
goals: Automatically extract discrete asks from uploaded questionnaires (PDF/Doc/CSV) and map them to Redwood canonical controls (SOC2/ISO/GDPR/HIPAA/DPA)
Compute a risk-priority score for each ask combining legal sensitivity, technical remediation effort estimate, and customer SLA tier
Provide a Console-first prioritized queue and remediation roadmap with suggested owner and estimated ETA
Create a machine-readable evidence bundle linking to existing artifacts (SOCs, config docs, KMS attestations) for quick responses
out_of_scope: Full natural language answering of questionnaire items (we return suggested evidence and templated responses in MVP)
Replacing Legal sign-off workflows — Legal remains final approver for contractual changes
success_metrics: Mean time to first draft response reduced from 14 days to <= 48 hours for P0/P1 customers
Reduction in manual Security review hours by 40% for triaged asks
% of asks automatically mapped to canonical control >= 75% in first-iteration evaluations
Sales win unblock rate increased by 30% for priority deals with questionnaires
acceptance_criteria: Upload flow accepts common questionnaire formats and returns a parsed list of discrete asks within 2 minutes for a 50-question PDF
Each parsed ask is tagged with a canonical control (SOC2/ISO/GDPR/HIPAA/DPA) or labeled 'unmapped' with rationale
Priority score is computed and visible in Console with breakdown (security impact, remediation effort, customer tier)
Suggested evidence links populate from a managed knowledge base and include linkability to S3/Drive/GitHub artifacts
Routing rules allow automatic assignment to Security triage or Sales enablement queues based on score and customer SLA
Audit entries are created for every mapping/event and visible in the security audit log
proposed_solution: Build a lightweight pipeline with three components: (1) Extractor service (uses hybrid OCR + LLM parsing) to split questionnaires into canonical asks; (2) Mapping service that matches asks to our canonical control inventory and computes a deterministic risk-priority score; (3) Console UI endpoint and API that shows a prioritized queue, evidence suggestions, and routing controls. Integrate with existing knowledge base and the Legal review workflow via webhooks.
milestones: Spec complete and stakeholder signoff (Security, Legal, Sales) - 2025-10-08
Prototype extractor + mapping with 50 historical questionnaires - 2025-10-22
Console UI wireframes and API contract - 2025-10-29
Integrate evidence KB and routing rules - 2025-11-05
Beta with Sales and Security for 3 customers - 2025-11-12
risks: Extraction accuracy may be low on noisy PDFs — plan to include human-in-loop correction UI
Mapping edge cases could overwhelm Legal — include confidence thresholds and auto-escalation
Knowledge base completeness: we may lack template evidence for uncommon asks — require KB curation effort
Privacy: uploaded questionnaires may contain customer PII; must ensure uploads land in encrypted storage and ACLs
